camel_example: aliyun vod DetachAppPolicyFromIdentity --region cn-hangzhou --PolicyNames VODAppFullAccess --IdentityType RamUser --AppId 'app-0000' --IdentityName test0000name
description_en: Invokes this operation to revoke application authorization from a specified account identity (Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role)
description_zh: 调用本接口为指定账号身份（RAM用户或RAM角色）撤销指定的应用授权
kebab_example: aliyun vod detach-app-policy-from-identity --identity-type RamUser --identity-name test0000name --app-id app-0000 --policy-names VODAppFullAccess --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachAppPolicyFromIdentity

parameters.help_en:
The identity type. Valid values:
- **RamUser**: Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
- **RamRole**: RAM role
parameters.help_zh:
身份类型，取值：
- **RamUser**：RAM用户。
- **RamRole**：RAM角色
parameters.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en:
The identity name.

- If the type is RamUser, specify the Resource Access Management (RAM) user ID.
- If the type is RamRole, specify the role name
parameters.help_zh:
身份名称。

- 当类型为RamUser时，传入RAM用户ID。
- 当类型为RamRole时，传入角色名称
parameters.name: identity_name

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. If the policy name is VODAppAdministratorAccess, this parameter is optional. For other policies, this parameter is required.
- Value (default): **app-1000000**.
- For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。当策略名称为VODAppAdministratorAccess时，该字段非必选。其他策略时，该字段必填。
- 取值（默认）：**app-1000000**。
- 使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The policy names. Separate multiple names with commas (,). Only system policies are supported. Valid values:
- **VODAppFullAccess**: permissions to manage and operate all resources in the application.
- **VODAppReadOnlyAccess**: read-only permissions for all resources in the application.
- **VODAppAdministratorAccess**: application administrator permissions
parameters.help_zh:
策略名称。多个名称使用英文逗号（,）分隔。暂时只支持设置为系统策略，取值：
- **VODAppFullAccess**：管理和操作应用下所有资源的权限。
- **VODAppReadOnlyAccess**：只读访问应用下所有资源的权限。
- **VODAppAdministratorAccess**：应用管理员权限
parameters.name: policy_names
